interface.longDescription: Six independent specialists, a Verifier and a Judge assess whether a project is worth building. COMPUTER-ONLY: includes its native Jury engine; requires a compatible local Codex login, Python 3.11+ and Node.js 20+. No global Jury installation or manual agent setup.
